headline: US stocks set to open higher as futures gap up amid softer oil, firmer gold and key ISM manufacturing data ahead
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) rise 0.37%, Dow Jones Futures (@YM) gain 0.33%, Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) advance 0.74%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) add 0.54% after last week's tech selloff
- Cloudflare (NET) trades roughly 2% higher pre-market
- Ford (F) gains pre-market as stronger 2026 guidance offsets a miss tied to EV charges and supply issues
- Robinhood Markets (HOOD) trades roughly 1.5% higher pre-market after disappointing revenue and user metrics
- Marriott International (MAR), Estée Lauder, Entergy (ETR), Check Point Software (CHKP), and Fox Corporation (FOXA) report earnings before the bell, with their moves expected to influence early trading
- Oil (@CL) prices fall sharply on US-Iran diplomatic signals related to the Middle East, while gold (@GC) prices move higher
- Asian equities trade mixed and major European indexes edge higher in early Monday activity
- Traders monitor the ISM Manufacturing PMI due at 10:00 AM ET for sector and cyclical demand signals
